body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one non-Critical physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn; reduce your next incoming Damage by 1 during that time.

surges.html: Extend suppression through the end of your next turn.
Suppress one additional Light physical Wound Condition for the same duration.

rider.title: Adaptation - Bulwark
rider.html: Assume Scaffolding (upkeep 1): maintain suppression of one non-Critical physical Wound's numerical penalties; your Movement is reduced by 1. All injuries remain recorded.
